name: PartLabel Dimensions for WooCommerce
author: mototema

sections.installation:
1. Upload the partlabel-dimensions-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate “PartLabel Dimensions for WooCommerce”.
  3. Open a WooCommerce product page or edit a product in the admin area.
  4. Choose the main product image or a gallery image from the PartLabel thumbnails.
  5. Edit the image, then click the check button in the editor to save the result to the product gallery.

Edited images are stored in the WordPress Media Library and appended to the WooCommerce product gallery.
sections.description:
Adds an “Add dimensions” button to WooCommerce product images.

Privacy

This plugin processes edited product images inside the site where it is installed. It does not contact external services, load remote executable code, or collect analytics/tracking data.
